trip.title: Incident reports
trip.description: Write down what happened while it is fresh. Owners, managers and the person who wrote a report can read it.

missingDiver.notMissing: No longer marked not back aboard
missingDiver.notAllowed: Only this departure’s crew, owners and managers can start a report.
missingDiver.failed: The report did not open. Tap again.
missingDiver.alerted: Owners alerted. Keep searching; the report can wait.
missingDiver.alertFailed: The alert did not go. Tap again, or call the owners.
missingDiver.notReached: Not reached yet. Call the owners now.
missingDiver.notAlerted: No alert stands for them here.
missingDiver.foundDone: Marked found. The owners have the all-clear.
missingDiver.foundPartial: Marked found. The all-clear did not reach every owner. Call them.
missingDiver.foundNoAllClear: Marked found. No all-clear was sent.
missingDiver.stillMissing: Still marked not back aboard. Mark them back aboard first.
missingDiver.offline: No signal: phone the owners or use VHF.

page.title: Incident report
page.draftNote: A draft. Its writer and the shop’s owners and managers can read it. Once filed it no longer changes, and anything learned later is added as a dated note.
page.filedNote: Filed by {name}, {date}. A filed report does not change. Add a dated note below for anything learned later.

form.locationHint: The dock, the boat deck, a spot on the reef.
form.whatHappenedHint: In order, as you saw it: times, depths, and who did what.
form.handoverDetailHint: The crew, the hospital, the chamber.
form.followUpHint: Who was notified (DAN, the training agency, the emergency contact), gear secured for inspection, what happens next.

people.title: People involved
people.description: Divers by their seat on this departure, crew by name, anyone else in your own words.
people.outsiderNameHint: Only for someone not on the lists.

file.title: File the report
file.description: Filing puts your name and the time on it. After that it does not change.
file.missingDiverWarning: Filing tells the owners now. Is the diver still missing?
file.needs: Before it can be filed, it needs:

gap.kind: What kind of incident it was

read.oxygenFor: Yes, for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

found.label: Found
found.help: Sends the owners who were alerted one all-clear by email. Only once they are marked back aboard.
found.allClearPartial: The all-clear did not reach every owner. Call them.

addenda.title: Later notes
addenda.description: Each note carries who wrote it and when. A note cannot be changed.
addenda.label: Add a note

notices.occurredAtInvalid: Give both a date and a time for when it happened, or leave both blank.
notices.handedOverAtInvalid: Give both a date and a time for the handover, or leave both blank.
notices.handedOverBeforeIncident: The handover time is before the incident. Check both times.
notices.oxygenMinutesInvalid: Minutes on oxygen must be a whole number up to 1440.
notices.textTooLong: One of the answers is too long. Shorten it and save again.
notices.incomplete: Not filed yet. Answer what is listed first.
notices.alreadyFiled: This report is already filed. Add a dated note instead.
notices.siteNotFound: That dive site is no longer on the shop’s list. Choose another.
notices.subjectNotFound: That person is not on this departure. Choose from the list.
notices.alreadyListed: That person is already on the report.
notices.nobodyChosen: Choose a person, or write a name.
notices.blankNote: Write the note before adding it.
notices.notYetFiled: File the report before adding a later note.
notices.held: A report on legal hold can’t be deleted. Release the hold first.
notices.alerted: The owners were alerted from this report, so it is kept. Mark the diver found instead.
notices.found: Marked found. The owners are sent an all-clear.
notices.stillMissing: Still marked not back aboard on the manifest. Mark them back aboard first.

discard.title: Delete this draft
discard.description: Only an owner can, and only before it is filed. It comes off this departure and the Reports page.
discard.message: Delete this draft? It leaves the screen, and its words are kept for seven years. A filed report can never be deleted.

hold.title: Legal hold
hold.descriptionOff: For an open claim. Keeps this report past its seven years. Only an owner can set or release it.
hold.descriptionOn: On hold. This report is kept until an owner releases the hold.
